title: Junior Virtual Assistant (Inbox & Client Support)
description: Looking for entry-level Virtual Assistants skilled in professional communication, calendar management, and remote correspondence.

titles.am: ጀማሪ ቨርቹዋል ረዳት (የኢሜይል እና ደንበኞች ድጋፍ)
titles.om: Gargaaraa Virtual Sadarkaa Jalqabaa (I-meelii fi Deeggarsa Maamilaa)
titles.so: Kaaliyaha Virtual-ka ee Heerka Hoose (Iimaylka & Taageerada Macmiilka)
titles.ar: مساعد افتراضي مبتدئ (إدارة البريد ودعم العملاء)

descriptions.en: Looking for entry-level Virtual Assistants skilled in professional communication, calendar management, and remote correspondence. Full accommodations provided.
descriptions.am: በሙያዊ የጽሁፍ ግንኙነት፣ የቀን መቁጠሪያ ማቀናጀት እና የርቀት ስራ ቅንጅት የተካኑ ጀማሪ ቨርቹዋል ረዳቶችን እንፈልጋለን። ሙሉ የፈተና ማመቻቸት ይደረጋል።
descriptions.om: Gargaartota Virtual sadarkaa jalqabaa qunnamtii ogummaa, qindoomina kaalaandarii fi hojii fageenyaa irratti dandeettii qaban barbaanna. Deeggarsi guutuun ni kennama.
descriptions.ti: ብሞያዊ ናይ ጽሑፍ ርክብ፣ ምምሕዳር ካላንደርን ናይ ርሕቐት ስራሕን ክእለት ዘለዎም ጀመርቲ ረዳትቲ ንደሊ ኣለና። ምሉእ ናይ ፈተና ምቹእነት ይግበር።
descriptions.so: Waxaan raadineynaa kaaliyeyaal xirfad u leh xiriirka shaqada, maareynta jadwalka, iyo shaqada fog. Fursado buuxa oo la xaqiijiyay.
descriptions.ar: مطلوب مساعدون افتراضيون مبتدئون يتمتعون بمهارات التواصل المهني، إدارة الجداول الزمنية، والمراسلات عن بُعد. كافة التسهيلات متوفرة.

schema_org.title: Junior Virtual Assistant
schema_org.description: Remote entry-level virtual assistant position with certified accessibility support.
schema_org.jobBenefits: Screen reader compatible testing; interview accommodations upon request.

title: Customer Support Communication Associate
description: Seeking communicators with strong English and regional language fluency to handle written customer inquiries.

descriptions.en: Seeking communicators with strong English and regional language fluency to handle written customer inquiries. Screen reader certified testing.
descriptions.am: የደንበኞችን የጽሁፍ ጥያቄዎች በእንግሊዝኛ እና በአካባቢ ቋንቋዎች ለመመለስ ብቁ የሆኑ ተግባቢዎችን እንፈልጋለን። የስክሪን አንባቢ ድጋፍ ሙሉ በሙሉ የተረጋገጠ ነው።
descriptions.om: Gaaffilee maamiltootaa barreeffamaa fi e-meeliin deebisuuf ogeessota afaan hedduu dandeettii qaban barbaanna. Deeggarsa Screen Reader guutuu qaba.
descriptions.ti: ሕቶታት ዓማዊል ብጽሑፍ ንምምላስ ብቑዓት ዝኾኑ ርክብ ፈጠርቲ ንደሊ ኣለና። ናይ ስክሪን ኣንባቢ ፈተና ተረጋጊጹ እዩ።
descriptions.so: Waxaan raadineynaa shaqsiyaad ku hadla luqado badan si ay uga jawaabaan su'aalaha qoraalka ah ee macaamiisha. Nidaamku wuxuu taageeraa Screen Reader.
descriptions.ar: البحث عن متخصصين في التواصل لإدارة استفسارات العملاء المكتوبة بعدة لغات. التقييم الوظيفي متوافق تماماً مع قارئات الشاشة.

title: AI Data Annotation & Accessibility Reviewer
description: Evaluate artificial intelligence outputs for East African languages and digital accessibility standards.

titles.am: የ AI ዳታ መረጃ ገምጋሚ እና የተደራሽነት ተንታኝ
titles.om: Qorataa Daataa AI fi Qulqullina Mijaawummaa
titles.ar: مقيّم بيانات الذكاء الاصطناعي ومعايير النفاذية الرقمية

descriptions.en: Evaluate artificial intelligence outputs for East African languages and digital accessibility standards. Screen reader users prioritized.
descriptions.am: የአርቲፊሻል ኢንተሊጀንስ ምላሾችን ለምስራቅ አፍሪካ ቋንቋዎች ተደራሽነት እና ጥራት ይገምግሙ። የስክሪን አንባቢ ተጠቃሚዎች ቅድሚያ ይሰጣቸዋል።
descriptions.om: Deebiiwwan AI afaanota Baha Afrikaatiif qulqullina isaanii gamaaggamaa. Fayyadamtoonni Screen Reader dursa argatu.
descriptions.ti: ምላሻት AI ንቋንቋታት ምብራቕ ኣፍሪቃን ዲጂታል ተበጻሕነትን ገምግሙ። ተጠቀምቲ ስክሪን ኣንባቢ ቀዳምነት ይወሃቦም።
descriptions.so: Qiimee jawaabaha sirdoonka macmalka ah ee luqadaha Bariga Afrika iyo helitaanka dhijitaalka ah.
descriptions.ar: تقييم مخرجات نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي للغات شرق إفريقيا ومعايير النفاذية الرقمية. الأولوية لمستخدمي قارئات الشاشة.

schema_org.title: AI Data Annotation & Accessibility Reviewer
